texts.title: Disbursement
texts.description: Send money to any bank or wallet, local or cross-border. Stablecoin in, local currency out, delivered on arrival.
texts.who:
Platforms, marketplaces, and payroll providers that need to pay people fast, whether across the street or across
the world.

what: Real-time PHP payouts to any bank or e-wallet via InstaPay.
Cross-border payouts across 4+ corridors, and growing.
Settle with stablecoins or pre-fund with fiat. Either way, same-day settlement.
